newsitem.title: CYPRUS: New-style Cyprus banknotes confuse public.
newsitem.headline: New-style Cyprus banknotes confuse public.

text.p: Cyprus's central bank on Tuesday said it would make adjustments to the colouring on new-style one pound notes after complaints people were mistaking them for fivers.
The purple fivers and the brown one pound notes banknotes which went into circulation in early May, though distinct in design, have similar colouring which confuses people, especially in poor light.
"Lots of people are complaining they are mixing them up," the manager of a busy shop in capital Nicosia told Reuters.
The central bank said it was in contact with the priners for slight adjustments to be made to the colours of the one-pound notes for future issues.
But it stuck to its guns that the colours should not confuse the public.

"The differences are apparent because the prevalent colour on the one pound note is light brown and on the five pound note purple," it said, adding that there was also a difference in the size of the two notes.
